name: Vital Power
body:
You know where to strike to most effectively empower your spells.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Magic, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Vital Magic feat, the DC of a spell cast during your spell combat class feature increases by +1. At 14th level, the spell’s DC increases by an additional +1.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
